name: Leaf Venation
recipe: Space-colonization venation: auxin sources seed a growing vein network that branches toward them (Runions/Nervous-System algorithm), thickening trunk veins over time -> leaf/coral vein tree filling the frame; regrow each section. COLOR (gold/green filaments on dark), fill frame.
kernel: space-colonization: node list + auxin points in S; grow toward nearest sources, draw thickening branches into a buffer
style: hyphae (default, gold filaments on dark). Also: leaf-botanical, cyanotype-diagram, nerve-red, ink-root.

name: Guilloché
recipe: Rose-engine / banknote guilloché: dense interwoven spirograph rosettes (epitrochoid families) forming a security-print lattice that slowly precesses; layered rings + a central rosette. Continuous precession = motion. Elegant fine lines filling the frame.
kernel: parametric: draw many epitrochoid curves (R,r,d params) as thin lines into a buffer with slight per-frame precession
style: engraved-currency (default, fine ink lines on toned ground). Also: neon-spirograph, blueprint, iridescent-foil, monochrome-etch.

name: Lorenz Attractor
recipe: Lorenz (or Rossler) attractor integrated in 3D, projected to 2D and accumulated into a density buffer -> the butterfly wings glowing; slow 3D rotation of the projection = motion. Distinct from Clifford/de Jong (those are 2D maps). COLOR by speed/depth.
kernel: integrate ODE (dt small, many steps/frame) into a fading density buffer; rotate projection on K.t; additive glow
style: plasma-ribbon (default, glowing color). Also: blueprint-wireframe, sumi-ink, thermal, iridescent.

name: Apollonian Gasket
recipe: Apollonian gasket via Descartes circle theorem: recursively pack tangent circles into curved triangular gaps, seeded -> infinite self-similar circle fractal filling the frame. Circles pulse/hue-cycle by depth on K.t. Distinct from circle_packing (random growth).
kernel: recursive circle generation (Descartes) to a depth budget (rebuild on seed), draw stroked/filled circles; <=~1500 circles
style: gold-leaf (default, warm circles on dark). Also: neon-outline, blueprint, riso-duotone, chiaroscuro.

name: Living Maze
recipe: Recursive-backtracker maze carves itself live across a grid, then a flood-fill glow-front sweeps the solved path in neon; re-carve each section with a new seed. Carving + sweeping = motion. Distinct from truchet. Fill frame.
kernel: grid maze gen (carve over K.t steps), draw walls; a BFS glow-front animates along corridors into a buffer
style: neon-corridor (default, glowing paths on dark). Also: blueprint, ink-labyrinth, circuit-board, phosphor.

name: Space-Filling Curve
recipe: A Hilbert (or Gosper/Peano) space-filling curve draws itself progressively as one continuous glowing line, order increasing then morphing; the curve slowly rotates/breathes. Continuous draw+rotate = motion. Fill frame, COLOR gradient along the path.
kernel: generate Hilbert path points for order N; draw a growing polyline with a hue gradient along arclength into a fade buffer
style: gradient-thread (default, hue along the path). Also: phosphor, blueprint, gold-circuit, sumi.

name: Low-Poly Gradient Mesh
recipe: A Delaunay triangulation of drifting points, each triangle flat-filled with a smooth gradient sampled from an underlying domain-warp color field -> a faceted low-poly gradient (crystalline but SMOOTH color, not gem-shaded). Points drift = motion. Distinct from voronoi_3d gem facets. COLOR rich.
kernel: triangulate ~80-150 drifting points (simple incremental Delaunay or a jittered grid), fill each tri with avg field color
style: aurora-facets (default, smooth color gradient). Also: stained-glass, thermal, blueprint-wireframe, pastel.

name: Volumetric God Rays
recipe: Crepuscular light rays: bright radial shafts emanating from an off-center source through drifting volumetric haze/dust, shafts flickering and sweeping; atmospheric depth. Source drifts, haze advects = motion. COLOR warm/cathedral, fill frame.
kernel: radial shafts (additive wedges/lines from a source) modulated by a drifting noise occlusion + dust motes; shadowBlur sparingly
style: cathedral (default, warm dusty light). Also: underwater-god-rays, neon-laser, thermal, monochrome-noir.

name: Rorschach Bloom
recipe: Symmetric inkblot: ink blooms diffuse and grow on a coarse buffer, mirrored across a vertical axis -> an evolving Rorschach that morphs through suggestive symmetric forms; new blooms each section. Diffusion+growth = motion. Bold ink on paper (COLOR options).
kernel: coarse pigment buffer, grow blooms via diffusion/reaction, mirror horizontally on render; upscale
style: black-ink (default, bold blot on cream). Also: sanguine-red, cyanotype, oil-slick, thermal.

name: Newton Fractal
recipe: Newton's method root-basin fractal for a polynomial (z^n-1 or animated roots): color by which root each pixel converges to + iteration shading -> intricate basin boundaries with fractal filaments; roots orbit on K.t so basins swirl. COLOR by root, fill frame.
kernel: per-pixel coarse buffer: Newton iterate z -= f/f', classify root -> palette + shade by iters; animate roots
style: stained-basin (default, saturated root colors). Also: metallic, blueprint-boundary, thermal, monochrome-ink.

name: Abelian Sandpile
recipe: Abelian sandpile: add grains to the center, topple cells with >=4 grains to 4 neighbors -> the self-organized-critical fractal mandala grows; add grains over K.t so it keeps expanding/re-toppling; reset each section. Growth+topples = motion. COLOR by grain count (0-3).
kernel: grid grain counts in S; add grains each step + topple to stability; draw cells by count via a 4-color palette; upscale
style: four-color (default, classic sandpile palette). Also: thermal, phosphor, blueprint, gold-mandala.

name: Superformula Bloom
recipe: Gielis superformula supershapes: nested morphing radial shapes (m,n1,n2,n3 params) drawn as glowing concentric contours that continuously morph through flowers/stars/gears/blobs; slow parameter drift = motion. Radial, hypnotic, fills frame. COLOR glowing.
kernel: parametric: for several nested scales, plot the superformula polar curve as a glowing closed contour; drift params on K.t
style: neon-bloom (default, glowing morphing shape). Also: ink-botanical, iridescent, blueprint, chrome.
